metadata.title: The Learning Council - Phase 1 Aggregated Raw Ideas Pool

ideas.name: Backward-Faded Worked Examples in Acetylcholine Esterase Hydrolysis
ideas.mechanism: In a 4-step AChE catalytic walkthrough (catalytic triad Ser203, His447, Glu334 attack, tetrahedral intermediate, ester cleavage, deacetylation), step 1 is fully worked, step 2 requires completing the intermediate, step 3 requires drawing the nucleophilic attack, and step 4 requires autonomous generation
ideas.expected_effect: Prevents cognitive overload during initial schema acquisition by systematically fading instructional guidance as expertise increases (Sweller & Renkl worked-example effect)
ideas.formatted: Backward-Faded Worked Examples in Acetylcholine Esterase Hydrolysis: In a 4-step AChE catalytic walkthrough (catalytic triad Ser203, His447, Glu334 attack, tetrahedral intermediate, ester cleavage, deacetylation), step 1 is fully worked, step 2 requires completing the intermediate, step 3 requires drawing the nucleophilic attack, and step 4 requires autonomous generation -> Prevents cognitive overload during initial schema acquisition by systematically fading instructional guidance as expertise increases (Sweller & Renkl worked-example effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Interleaved Retrieval of Sympathomimetic vs. Parasympathomimetic Organ Responses
ideas.mechanism: Randomly alternate diagnostic quiz cards between adrenergic (mydriasis, bronchodilation, tachycardia) and cholinergic (miosis, bronchoconstriction, bradycardia) clinical scenarios rather than blocking by autonomic branch
ideas.expected_effect: Forces discriminative contrastive processing between autonomic divisions and eliminates spurious block-level context cues (Rohrer & Taylor interleaving effect)
ideas.formatted: Interleaved Retrieval of Sympathomimetic vs. Parasympathomimetic Organ Responses: Randomly alternate diagnostic quiz cards between adrenergic (mydriasis, bronchodilation, tachycardia) and cholinergic (miosis, bronchoconstriction, bradycardia) clinical scenarios rather than blocking by autonomic branch -> Forces discriminative contrastive processing between autonomic divisions and eliminates spurious block-level context cues (Rohrer & Taylor interleaving effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Pre-Testing Prior to Dose-Response Curve Exposition
ideas.mechanism: Require learners to predict whether a competitive antagonist shifts the EC50 rightward or decreases the Emax before showing the log concentration-response curve
ideas.expected_effect: Activates prior physiological knowledge schemas and primes selective visual attention to curve inflection points upon revelation (Richland, Kornell & Kao pre-testing effect)
ideas.formatted: Pre-Testing Prior to Dose-Response Curve Exposition: Require learners to predict whether a competitive antagonist shifts the EC50 rightward or decreases the Emax before showing the log concentration-response curve -> Activates prior physiological knowledge schemas and primes selective visual attention to curve inflection points upon revelation (Richland, Kornell & Kao pre-testing effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Dual-Modality Co-Location in SMILES to Pharmacophore Mapping
ideas.mechanism: Render pharmacophoric labels (e.g., quaternary amine cationic head, ester dipole) directly superimposed onto the 2D SVG molecular structure rather than in an adjacent text legend
ideas.expected_effect: Eliminates split-attention visual saccades, freeing working memory capacity for chemical property encoding (Sweller & Mayer split-attention principle)
ideas.formatted: Dual-Modality Co-Location in SMILES to Pharmacophore Mapping: Render pharmacophoric labels (e.g., quaternary amine cationic head, ester dipole) directly superimposed onto the 2D SVG molecular structure rather than in an adjacent text legend -> Eliminates split-attention visual saccades, freeing working memory capacity for chemical property encoding (Sweller & Mayer split-attention principle) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Expanding-Interval Spaced Retrieval for Autonomic Receptor Subtypes
ideas.mechanism: Schedule automated retrieval prompts for M1-M5 and Alpha-1, Alpha-2, Beta-1, Beta-2 G-protein coupling (Gq, Gi, Gs) at expanding intervals of 15 minutes, 1 day, 3 days, and 7 days
ideas.expected_effect: Strengthens long-term cortical storage strength and retrieval accessibility while dramatically attenuating forgetting curve decay (Cepeda et al. spacing effect)
ideas.formatted: Expanding-Interval Spaced Retrieval for Autonomic Receptor Subtypes: Schedule automated retrieval prompts for M1-M5 and Alpha-1, Alpha-2, Beta-1, Beta-2 G-protein coupling (Gq, Gi, Gs) at expanding intervals of 15 minutes, 1 day, 3 days, and 7 days -> Strengthens long-term cortical storage strength and retrieval accessibility while dramatically attenuating forgetting curve decay (Cepeda et al. spacing effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Self-Explanation Prompting During Bioisosteric Replacement
ideas.mechanism: Pause learners after presenting procaine versus procainamide with a mandatory prompt: 'Explain in one sentence why replacing an ester with an amide increases resistance to plasma pseudocholinesterase'
ideas.expected_effect: Triggers generative cognitive processing and surfaces latent gaps in the learner's mental model of amidase versus esterase enzymatic kinetics (Chi et al. self-explanation effect)
ideas.formatted: Self-Explanation Prompting During Bioisosteric Replacement: Pause learners after presenting procaine versus procainamide with a mandatory prompt: 'Explain in one sentence why replacing an ester with an amide increases resistance to plasma pseudocholinesterase' -> Triggers generative cognitive processing and surfaces latent gaps in the learner's mental model of amidase versus esterase enzymatic kinetics (Chi et al. self-explanation effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Contrastive Case Pair Analysis for Chiral Drug Eutomers
ideas.mechanism: Present (R)-norepinephrine and (S)-norepinephrine side-by-side in synchronized 3D views, visually highlighting the steric clash of the (S)-distomer with the adrenergic receptor pocket
ideas.expected_effect: Focuses focal visual attention onto critical discriminatory stereochemical features rather than superficial molecular similarities (Bransford & Schwartz contrastive cases)
ideas.formatted: Contrastive Case Pair Analysis for Chiral Drug Eutomers: Present (R)-norepinephrine and (S)-norepinephrine side-by-side in synchronized 3D views, visually highlighting the steric clash of the (S)-distomer with the adrenergic receptor pocket -> Focuses focal visual attention onto critical discriminatory stereochemical features rather than superficial molecular similarities (Bransford & Schwartz contrastive cases) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Generation Effect via Incomplete Receptor Cascade Diagrams
ideas.mechanism: Present an incomplete Gq intracellular signaling diagram (PLC-beta -> [?] -> IP3 + DAG -> Ca2+ release) and require learners to select the missing PIP2 substrate from memory rather than passive inspection
ideas.expected_effect: Produces stronger episodic and semantic memory traces compared to passive reading through effortful mental generation (Slamecka & Graf generation effect)
ideas.formatted: Generation Effect via Incomplete Receptor Cascade Diagrams: Present an incomplete Gq intracellular signaling diagram (PLC-beta -> [?] -> IP3 + DAG -> Ca2+ release) and require learners to select the missing PIP2 substrate from memory rather than passive inspection -> Produces stronger episodic and semantic memory traces compared to passive reading through effortful mental generation (Slamecka & Graf generation effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Error-Driven Hypercorrection in Baroreceptor Reflex Predictions
ideas.mechanism: Solicit a high-confidence prediction on whether IV phenylephrine increases or decreases heart rate before revealing the reflex parasympathetic bradycardia compensation
ideas.expected_effect: High-confidence errors provoke an acute orienting response and deep cognitive re-encoding, permanently overwriting the intuitive misconception (Butterfield & Metcalfe hypercorrection effect)
ideas.formatted: Error-Driven Hypercorrection in Baroreceptor Reflex Predictions: Solicit a high-confidence prediction on whether IV phenylephrine increases or decreases heart rate before revealing the reflex parasympathetic bradycardia compensation -> High-confidence errors provoke an acute orienting response and deep cognitive re-encoding, permanently overwriting the intuitive misconception (Butterfield & Metcalfe hypercorrection effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Segmented Micro-Steps for Organophosphate Aging Chemistry
ideas.mechanism: Deconstruct the mechanism of sarin AChE aging (nucleophilic Ser phosphorylation, transition state, alkyl-oxygen bond cleavage, refractory monoalkylphospho-enzyme) into four isolated 35-word sequential steps
ideas.expected_effect: Keeps transient chemical transition states within the 4-item working memory capacity ceiling, preventing cognitive overload (Sweller segmenting principle)
ideas.formatted: Segmented Micro-Steps for Organophosphate Aging Chemistry: Deconstruct the mechanism of sarin AChE aging (nucleophilic Ser phosphorylation, transition state, alkyl-oxygen bond cleavage, refractory monoalkylphospho-enzyme) into four isolated 35-word sequential steps -> Keeps transient chemical transition states within the 4-item working memory capacity ceiling, preventing cognitive overload (Sweller segmenting principle) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Varied Context Retrieval for Muscarinic Antagonist Toxicity
ideas.mechanism: Test atropine toxic symptoms (anticholinergic toxidrome) across three varied scenario vignettes: belladonna berry ingestion, jimsonweed tea overdose, and psychiatric drug interaction
ideas.expected_effect: Dismantles brittle context-dependent retrieval and forms generalized, abstract diagnostic schemas (Bjork & Bjork contextual variation)
ideas.formatted: Varied Context Retrieval for Muscarinic Antagonist Toxicity: Test atropine toxic symptoms (anticholinergic toxidrome) across three varied scenario vignettes: belladonna berry ingestion, jimsonweed tea overdose, and psychiatric drug interaction -> Dismantles brittle context-dependent retrieval and forms generalized, abstract diagnostic schemas (Bjork & Bjork contextual variation) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Modality Effect Optimization in Cardiac Autonomic Innervation
ideas.mechanism: Pair dynamic visual vector animations of SA node action potential depolarization with concise synchronized audio narration rather than on-screen paragraph text
ideas.expected_effect: Expands effective working memory capacity across phonological and visuospatial sketchpad subsystems simultaneously (Mayer & Moreno dual-processing modality effect)
ideas.formatted: Modality Effect Optimization in Cardiac Autonomic Innervation: Pair dynamic visual vector animations of SA node action potential depolarization with concise synchronized audio narration rather than on-screen paragraph text -> Expands effective working memory capacity across phonological and visuospatial sketchpad subsystems simultaneously (Mayer & Moreno dual-processing modality effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Metacognitive Calibration Prompts Prior to SAR Predictions
ideas.mechanism: Ask learners to rate their confidence (0-100%) in predicting nicotinic versus muscarinic selectivity for carbamylcholine before revealing experimental receptor binding data
ideas.expected_effect: Exposes the illusion of explanatory depth, calibrating metacognitive self-assessment accuracy and sharpening post-feedback attention (Koriat metacognitive monitoring)
ideas.formatted: Metacognitive Calibration Prompts Prior to SAR Predictions: Ask learners to rate their confidence (0-100%) in predicting nicotinic versus muscarinic selectivity for carbamylcholine before revealing experimental receptor binding data -> Exposes the illusion of explanatory depth, calibrating metacognitive self-assessment accuracy and sharpening post-feedback attention (Koriat metacognitive monitoring) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Subgoal Labeling in Catecholamine Biosynthesis Sequences
ideas.mechanism: Visually cluster and explicitly label the functional stages of epinephrine synthesis: 'Step 1: Ring Hydroxylation (Rate-Limiting)', 'Step 2: Decarboxylation', 'Step 3: Side-Chain Hydroxylation', and 'Step 4: N-Methylation'
ideas.expected_effect: Organizes procedural biochemical steps into reusable hierarchical schemas, improving transfer to novel metabolic pathways (Catrambone subgoal learning)
ideas.formatted: Subgoal Labeling in Catecholamine Biosynthesis Sequences: Visually cluster and explicitly label the functional stages of epinephrine synthesis: 'Step 1: Ring Hydroxylation (Rate-Limiting)', 'Step 2: Decarboxylation', 'Step 3: Side-Chain Hydroxylation', and 'Step 4: N-Methylation' -> Organizes procedural biochemical steps into reusable hierarchical schemas, improving transfer to novel metabolic pathways (Catrambone subgoal learning) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Feedback Timing Delay on Log-Dose Curve Interpretations
ideas.mechanism: Withhold explanatory feedback on Schild regression slope calculations until the student has completed a 3-problem diagnostic battery, rather than showing immediate answers after each step
ideas.expected_effect: Prevents superficial feedback dependency and encourages autonomous internal consistency verification (Kulik & Kulik delay retention effect)
ideas.formatted: Feedback Timing Delay on Log-Dose Curve Interpretations: Withhold explanatory feedback on Schild regression slope calculations until the student has completed a 3-problem diagnostic battery, rather than showing immediate answers after each step -> Prevents superficial feedback dependency and encourages autonomous internal consistency verification (Kulik & Kulik delay retention effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Worked-Example to Problem Matching in pKa Ionization Calculations
ideas.mechanism: Provide two worked Henderson-Hasselbalch solutions for weak acids (aspirin in stomach pH 1.5 vs intestine pH 6.8), then require learners to pair a novel unworked drug problem (phenobarbital) with its structural calculation twin
ideas.expected_effect: Promotes deep structural schema abstraction over superficial algorithmic number plugging (Renkl example-problem matching)
ideas.formatted: Worked-Example to Problem Matching in pKa Ionization Calculations: Provide two worked Henderson-Hasselbalch solutions for weak acids (aspirin in stomach pH 1.5 vs intestine pH 6.8), then require learners to pair a novel unworked drug problem (phenobarbital) with its structural calculation twin -> Promotes deep structural schema abstraction over superficial algorithmic number plugging (Renkl example-problem matching) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Adaptive Expertise Reversal in Adrenergic Pharmacophore Training
ideas.mechanism: Automatically strip color-coded pharmacophore scaffolding (cationic center, aromatic ring, beta-hydroxyl) once a learner demonstrates 3 consecutive accurate beta-blocker classifications
ideas.expected_effect: Eliminates instructional redundancy that impairs processing efficiency in learners with maturing domain schemas (Kalyuga expertise reversal effect)
ideas.formatted: Adaptive Expertise Reversal in Adrenergic Pharmacophore Training: Automatically strip color-coded pharmacophore scaffolding (cationic center, aromatic ring, beta-hydroxyl) once a learner demonstrates 3 consecutive accurate beta-blocker classifications -> Eliminates instructional redundancy that impairs processing efficiency in learners with maturing domain schemas (Kalyuga expertise reversal effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Free-Recall Retrieval Dump Prior to SLUDGEM Toxidrome Recognition
ideas.mechanism: Prompt learners to type all physiological manifestations of cholinergic toxidrome from memory on a blank screen before showing structured multiple-choice recognition options
ideas.expected_effect: Deepens retrieval pathways and exposes specific autonomic target organ omissions far more effectively than passive recognition (Karpicke free recall testing effect)
ideas.formatted: Free-Recall Retrieval Dump Prior to SLUDGEM Toxidrome Recognition: Prompt learners to type all physiological manifestations of cholinergic toxidrome from memory on a blank screen before showing structured multiple-choice recognition options -> Deepens retrieval pathways and exposes specific autonomic target organ omissions far more effectively than passive recognition (Karpicke free recall testing effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Progressive Complexity Scaffolding in Pharmacokinetic Clearance
ideas.mechanism: Sequence PK clearance instruction strictly across 3 stages: single-compartment IV bolus elimination first, then oral absorption kinetics (ka), and finally multi-compartment non-linear saturation kinetics
ideas.expected_effect: Maintains intrinsic cognitive load within working memory limits while establishing solid prerequisite baseline schemas (van Merriënboer 4C/ID scaffolding)
ideas.formatted: Progressive Complexity Scaffolding in Pharmacokinetic Clearance: Sequence PK clearance instruction strictly across 3 stages: single-compartment IV bolus elimination first, then oral absorption kinetics (ka), and finally multi-compartment non-linear saturation kinetics -> Maintains intrinsic cognitive load within working memory limits while establishing solid prerequisite baseline schemas (van Merriënboer 4C/ID scaffolding) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Dual-Coding of Receptor Affinity and Dissociation Constants
ideas.mechanism: Display numerical Kd values alongside a synchronized dynamic SVG bar showing occupied vs unoccupied receptor fractions and atomic electrostatic contact pins
ideas.expected_effect: Creates dual verbal-symbolic and nonverbal-spatial mental representations that facilitate associative cross-modal retrieval (Paivio dual coding theory)
ideas.formatted: Dual-Coding of Receptor Affinity and Dissociation Constants: Display numerical Kd values alongside a synchronized dynamic SVG bar showing occupied vs unoccupied receptor fractions and atomic electrostatic contact pins -> Creates dual verbal-symbolic and nonverbal-spatial mental representations that facilitate associative cross-modal retrieval (Paivio dual coding theory) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Productive Failure in Designing a Selective Beta-2 Agonist
ideas.mechanism: Challenge learners to modify epinephrine's structure to minimize cardiac beta-1 tachycardia prior to teaching the bulky N-tert-butyl substitution (albuterol/salbutamol)
ideas.expected_effect: Illuminates structural mechanistic challenges and prepares cognitive schemas to encode the formal SAR rationale with high receptivity (Kapur productive failure)
ideas.formatted: Productive Failure in Designing a Selective Beta-2 Agonist: Challenge learners to modify epinephrine's structure to minimize cardiac beta-1 tachycardia prior to teaching the bulky N-tert-butyl substitution (albuterol/salbutamol) -> Illuminates structural mechanistic challenges and prepares cognitive schemas to encode the formal SAR rationale with high receptivity (Kapur productive failure) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Isolated-Elements First Presentation in Ganglionic Transmission
ideas.mechanism: Teach the isolated biophysics of nicotinic NN pentameric ligand-gated ion channels and hexamethonium blockade before introducing dual-innervated autonomic organ dominance
ideas.expected_effect: Reduces element interactivity during initial encoding, preventing working memory exhaustion before system integration (Pollock, Chandler & Sweller isolated-elements effect)
ideas.formatted: Isolated-Elements First Presentation in Ganglionic Transmission: Teach the isolated biophysics of nicotinic NN pentameric ligand-gated ion channels and hexamethonium blockade before introducing dual-innervated autonomic organ dominance -> Reduces element interactivity during initial encoding, preventing working memory exhaustion before system integration (Pollock, Chandler & Sweller isolated-elements effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Distributed Spaced Practice in Lineweaver-Burk Kinetic Plots
ideas.mechanism: Distribute 6 practice problems comparing competitive and non-competitive enzyme inhibition across three separate 48-hour spaced sessions rather than a single massed study block
ideas.expected_effect: Engages memory trace reactivation and consolidation, yielding superior 30-day retention of slope (Km/Vmax) and intercept transformations (Dempster spacing effect)
ideas.formatted: Distributed Spaced Practice in Lineweaver-Burk Kinetic Plots: Distribute 6 practice problems comparing competitive and non-competitive enzyme inhibition across three separate 48-hour spaced sessions rather than a single massed study block -> Engages memory trace reactivation and consolidation, yielding superior 30-day retention of slope (Km/Vmax) and intercept transformations (Dempster spacing effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Test-Potentiated Learning in Catecholamine Reuptake Mechanisms
ideas.mechanism: Administer a 2-item diagnostic quiz on NET and DAT transporter localization immediately prior to introducing cocaine and methylphenidate pharmacology
ideas.expected_effect: Primes focused attentional encoding during subsequent instructional text by highlighting critical knowledge boundaries (Arnold & McDermott test-potentiated learning)
ideas.formatted: Test-Potentiated Learning in Catecholamine Reuptake Mechanisms: Administer a 2-item diagnostic quiz on NET and DAT transporter localization immediately prior to introducing cocaine and methylphenidate pharmacology -> Primes focused attentional encoding during subsequent instructional text by highlighting critical knowledge boundaries (Arnold & McDermott test-potentiated learning) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Concrete-to-Abstract Fading in Beta-Arrestin Desensitization
ideas.mechanism: Depict G-protein-coupled receptor kinase (GRK) phosphorylation and beta-arrestin binding using anatomical cell membrane illustrations first, fading across 4 steps into abstract 2-state kinetic graphs
ideas.expected_effect: Grounds concrete physical intuitions before transitioning cognitive schemas to transferrable abstract mathematical representations (Goldstone & Son concretion fading)
ideas.formatted: Concrete-to-Abstract Fading in Beta-Arrestin Desensitization: Depict G-protein-coupled receptor kinase (GRK) phosphorylation and beta-arrestin binding using anatomical cell membrane illustrations first, fading across 4 steps into abstract 2-state kinetic graphs -> Grounds concrete physical intuitions before transitioning cognitive schemas to transferrable abstract mathematical representations (Goldstone & Son concretion fading) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Retrieval-Induced Facilitation of Antidote Mechanisms
ideas.mechanism: Prompt active retrieval of atropine's muscarinic receptor competitive blockade before introducing pralidoxime's catalytic nucleophilic reactivation of phosphorylated acetylcholinesterase
ideas.expected_effect: Activating the primary symptom-relief antidote schema creates an associative hook that accelerates encoding of complementary causal antidote pathways (Chan, McDermott & Roediger)
ideas.formatted: Retrieval-Induced Facilitation of Antidote Mechanisms: Prompt active retrieval of atropine's muscarinic receptor competitive blockade before introducing pralidoxime's catalytic nucleophilic reactivation of phosphorylated acetylcholinesterase -> Activating the primary symptom-relief antidote schema creates an associative hook that accelerates encoding of complementary causal antidote pathways (Chan, McDermott & Roediger) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Signaling and Visual Cues in Sympathetic Outflow Diagrams
ideas.mechanism: Apply bold high-contrast borders and directional pulsing cues along preganglionic thoracolumbar pathways while muting surrounding spinal cord anatomy
ideas.expected_effect: Directs involuntary visual attention to essential autonomic synaptic relay junctions, eliminating visual search overhead (Mautone & Mayer signaling principle)
ideas.formatted: Signaling and Visual Cues in Sympathetic Outflow Diagrams: Apply bold high-contrast borders and directional pulsing cues along preganglionic thoracolumbar pathways while muting surrounding spinal cord anatomy -> Directs involuntary visual attention to essential autonomic synaptic relay junctions, eliminating visual search overhead (Mautone & Mayer signaling principle) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Interleaved Calculation Tasks for Acidic vs. Basic Drug Excretion
ideas.mechanism: Interleave practice calculations for urinary ion trapping between weak acids (aspirin, pKa 3.5) and weak bases (amphetamine, pKa 9.9) under variable urine pH conditions
ideas.expected_effect: Inhibits rote algorithmic plugging and trains learners to actively verify conjugate acid-base identity before applying Henderson-Hasselbalch equations (Taylor & Rohrer)
ideas.formatted: Interleaved Calculation Tasks for Acidic vs. Basic Drug Excretion: Interleave practice calculations for urinary ion trapping between weak acids (aspirin, pKa 3.5) and weak bases (amphetamine, pKa 9.9) under variable urine pH conditions -> Inhibits rote algorithmic plugging and trains learners to actively verify conjugate acid-base identity before applying Henderson-Hasselbalch equations (Taylor & Rohrer) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Delayed Judgments of Learning on Autonomic Receptor Distribution
ideas.mechanism: Ask learners to predict their probability of correctly recalling ocular, bronchial, and cardiac receptor distributions 15 minutes after module completion rather than immediately at the end of the step
ideas.expected_effect: Shifts metacognitive monitoring from transient working memory fluency to diagnostic long-term memory retrieval strength (Nelson & Dunlosky delayed JOL effect)
ideas.formatted: Delayed Judgments of Learning on Autonomic Receptor Distribution: Ask learners to predict their probability of correctly recalling ocular, bronchial, and cardiac receptor distributions 15 minutes after module completion rather than immediately at the end of the step -> Shifts metacognitive monitoring from transient working memory fluency to diagnostic long-term memory retrieval strength (Nelson & Dunlosky delayed JOL effect) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Subgoal-Labeled Walkthroughs for AChE Inhibitor Chemical Classes
ideas.mechanism: Label chemical transformations as 'Subgoal A: Active Site Docking', 'Subgoal B: Covalent Intermediate Formation', and 'Subgoal C: Hydrolytic Regeneration Half-Life' across edrophonium, neostigmine, and echothiophate
ideas.expected_effect: Enables learners to construct structural taxonomies categorizing reversible, carbamoylating, and phosphorylating inhibitors by underlying reaction mechanisms (Catrambone)
ideas.formatted: Subgoal-Labeled Walkthroughs for AChE Inhibitor Chemical Classes: Label chemical transformations as 'Subgoal A: Active Site Docking', 'Subgoal B: Covalent Intermediate Formation', and 'Subgoal C: Hydrolytic Regeneration Half-Life' across edrophonium, neostigmine, and echothiophate -> Enables learners to construct structural taxonomies categorizing reversible, carbamoylating, and phosphorylating inhibitors by underlying reaction mechanisms (Catrambone) [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Interactive SMILES Atom Deletion for Pharmacophore Boundary Discovery
ideas.mechanism: Learner clicks to delete specific functional atoms on acetylcholine (e.g. carbonyl oxygen, ester oxygen, methyl groups) and observes instant real-time drops on a simulated muscarinic affinity gauge
ideas.expected_effect: Uses self-directed perturbation to rapidly delineate necessary versus dispensable structural elements in the learner's mental pharmacophore model
ideas.formatted: Interactive SMILES Atom Deletion for Pharmacophore Boundary Discovery: Learner clicks to delete specific functional atoms on acetylcholine (e.g. carbonyl oxygen, ester oxygen, methyl groups) and observes instant real-time drops on a simulated muscarinic affinity gauge -> Uses self-directed perturbation to rapidly delineate necessary versus dispensable structural elements in the learner's mental pharmacophore model [plausible]

ideas.name: Thermodynamic Kinetic Energy Slider for Drug-Target Residence Time
ideas.mechanism: Learner drags a thermodynamic slider to visualize how microscopic bond vibrations affect the dissociation rate constant (koff) and receptor residence time (tau = 1/koff)
ideas.expected_effect: Converts static affinity conceptions into dynamic temporal kinetic schemas governing sustained drug action
ideas.formatted: Thermodynamic Kinetic Energy Slider for Drug-Target Residence Time: Learner drags a thermodynamic slider to visualize how microscopic bond vibrations affect the dissociation rate constant (koff) and receptor residence time (tau = 1/koff) -> Converts static affinity conceptions into dynamic temporal kinetic schemas governing sustained drug action [plausible]

ideas.name: Dual-Axis Dose-Response Curve Dragging for Antagonist Classes
ideas.mechanism: Learner physically drags an antagonist slider across a log concentration-response plot: competitive antagonists shift EC50 rightward with unchanged Emax, while noncompetitive antagonists depress maximal response
ideas.expected_effect: Spatial motor manipulation coupled with immediate visual constraint feedback anchors the fundamental operational distinction between orthosteric and allosteric antagonism
ideas.formatted: Dual-Axis Dose-Response Curve Dragging for Antagonist Classes: Learner physically drags an antagonist slider across a log concentration-response plot: competitive antagonists shift EC50 rightward with unchanged Emax, while noncompetitive antagonists depress maximal response -> Spatial motor manipulation coupled with immediate visual constraint feedback anchors the fundamental operational distinction between orthosteric and allosteric antagonism [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: H-Bond Donor/Acceptor Color Mask Fading in Nicotinic Receptors
ideas.mechanism: Display hydrogen bond donor atoms in cyan and acceptor atoms in orange on nicotine, then fade the masks and challenge the learner to correctly tap the corresponding features on an unannotated lobeline scaffold
ideas.expected_effect: Fosters analogical schema transfer across structurally divergent chemical families targeting identical receptor pockets
ideas.formatted: H-Bond Donor/Acceptor Color Mask Fading in Nicotinic Receptors: Display hydrogen bond donor atoms in cyan and acceptor atoms in orange on nicotine, then fade the masks and challenge the learner to correctly tap the corresponding features on an unannotated lobeline scaffold -> Fosters analogical schema transfer across structurally divergent chemical families targeting identical receptor pockets [plausible]

ideas.name: Inverted Baroreceptor Feedback Loop Simulator with Reflex Latency
ideas.mechanism: Learner simulates norepinephrine infusion and must manually drag a heart rate dial downward before an on-screen arterial pressure timer triggers hypertensive failure
ideas.expected_effect: Forces active mental simulation of negative feedback homeostatic latency and vagal nerve reflex compensatory dynamics
ideas.formatted: Inverted Baroreceptor Feedback Loop Simulator with Reflex Latency: Learner simulates norepinephrine infusion and must manually drag a heart rate dial downward before an on-screen arterial pressure timer triggers hypertensive failure -> Forces active mental simulation of negative feedback homeostatic latency and vagal nerve reflex compensatory dynamics [plausible]

ideas.name: Electrostatic Potential Surface Peeling for Tetrazole Bioisosterism
ideas.mechanism: Learner toggles between electron density surface mesh and 2D skeletal formulas for carboxylic acid and 5-substituted tetrazole rings on an angiotensin/adrenergic ligand
ideas.expected_effect: Connects visual 3D spatial charge distribution intuition directly with 2D chemical nomenclature representations
ideas.formatted: Electrostatic Potential Surface Peeling for Tetrazole Bioisosterism: Learner toggles between electron density surface mesh and 2D skeletal formulas for carboxylic acid and 5-substituted tetrazole rings on an angiotensin/adrenergic ligand -> Connects visual 3D spatial charge distribution intuition directly with 2D chemical nomenclature representations [plausible]

ideas.name: Pupil Constriction/Dilation Direct-Manipulation Dial
ideas.mechanism: Learner drags a slider from pure sympathetic to pure parasympathetic tone, observing real-time SVG vector dilation of iris radial muscle (alpha-1) versus constriction of circular sphincter muscle (M3)
ideas.expected_effect: Bypasses rote text memorization of ocular innervation via direct visual-causal physical manipulation
ideas.formatted: Pupil Constriction/Dilation Direct-Manipulation Dial: Learner drags a slider from pure sympathetic to pure parasympathetic tone, observing real-time SVG vector dilation of iris radial muscle (alpha-1) versus constriction of circular sphincter muscle (M3) -> Bypasses rote text memorization of ocular innervation via direct visual-causal physical manipulation [plausible]

ideas.name: Rate-Limiting Enzyme Bottleneck Simulation in Epinephrine Synthesis
ideas.mechanism: Learner pulses substrate molecules into Tyrosine Hydroxylase versus PNMT, observing downstream product accumulation curves plateau abruptly when tyrosine hydroxylase saturates
ideas.expected_effect: Visualizing enzymatic kinetic bottlenecks solidifies the cognitive schema of metabolic rate-limiting control
ideas.formatted: Rate-Limiting Enzyme Bottleneck Simulation in Epinephrine Synthesis: Learner pulses substrate molecules into Tyrosine Hydroxylase versus PNMT, observing downstream product accumulation curves plateau abruptly when tyrosine hydroxylase saturates -> Visualizing enzymatic kinetic bottlenecks solidifies the cognitive schema of metabolic rate-limiting control [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Virtual Schild Plot Linearization Morphing Widget
ideas.mechanism: An interactive toggle animates a family of rightward-shifted sigmoidal agonist dose-response curves smoothly collapsing into a single linear Schild regression line with unity slope
ideas.expected_effect: Reduces extraneous cognitive load involved in abstracting mathematical coordinate transformations from raw pharmacological bioassay data
ideas.formatted: Virtual Schild Plot Linearization Morphing Widget: An interactive toggle animates a family of rightward-shifted sigmoidal agonist dose-response curves smoothly collapsing into a single linear Schild regression line with unity slope -> Reduces extraneous cognitive load involved in abstracting mathematical coordinate transformations from raw pharmacological bioassay data [plausible]

ideas.name: Interactive pKa Buffer Chamber with Dynamic Membrane Permeability
ideas.mechanism: Learner adjusts simulated stomach pH from 1.5 to 8.0 to observe real-time ratio changes of ionized to unionized species and passive diffusion flux across a lipid bilayer partition
ideas.expected_effect: Grounds the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation into concrete physical molecular partitioning behavior across biological membranes
ideas.formatted: Interactive pKa Buffer Chamber with Dynamic Membrane Permeability: Learner adjusts simulated stomach pH from 1.5 to 8.0 to observe real-time ratio changes of ionized to unionized species and passive diffusion flux across a lipid bilayer partition -> Grounds the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation into concrete physical molecular partitioning behavior across biological membranes [evidence-backed]

ideas.name: Stereochemical 3D Handshake Alignment Widget for Epinephrine Enantiomers

ideas.name: 2-Parameter Logistic (2PL) Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT)
ideas.mechanism: Item bank questions are parameterized by difficulty (b) and discrimination (a); after each response, maximum Fisher information selection serves the next item nearest the learner's estimated latent ability (theta), stopping when the standard error of measurement drops below 0.30.
ideas.expected_effect: Cuts testing time by 50% while estimating true student pharmacology knowledge with twice the precision of fixed-length quizzes.

ideas.name: Pre-Test / Post-Test Normalized Learning Gain (Hake's Gain) Tracking
ideas.mechanism: Pre-module 3-question diagnostic probes are paired with isomorphic post-module challenge steps, calculating Hake's normalized gain score g = (%post - %pre)/(100 - %pre) per learner and per module cohort.
ideas.expected_effect: Isolates true instructional value-add from prior student background knowledge, highlighting modules that fail to shift conceptual understanding regardless of raw post-test scores.

all_ideas.expected_effect: Creates viral in-person dorm study energy that spreads organically across pharmacy faculties with zero backend server coordination

all_ideas.name: Synthetic Ghost Tutor Replay of Top Student Problem Paths
all_ideas.mechanism: Record the exact click-and-drag timing of a top student solving a complex SAR isostere problem into a 2KB JSON sequence and replay it as a dynamic worked example
all_ideas.expected_effect: Delivers the cognitive scaffolding of expert worked examples at zero video recording, rendering, or bandwidth overhead
